noise_allowance.text: Norm in which contraction is measured: ||d_k||_tau = max_i |d_k,i|/tau_i. q = min(0.9, the larger of the last two observed ratios ||d_k||_tau/||d_k-1||_tau); with only one ratio, that ratio. Norm-level bound E_i^norm = tau_i * ||d_last||_tau * q/(1-q); with exactly one increment, E_i = tau_i * ||d_last||_tau. Per-row bound for rows whose last two increments have the same sign (d_last,i * d_prev,i > 0): |d_last,i| * q_i/(1-q_i), q_i = min(0.9, |d_last,i|/|d_prev,i|); 0 for sign-changing rows. E_i = max(E_i^norm, per-row bound). E is UNAVAILABLE (test undecidable; goes to R-PAIR) when: no increment is observed; a tau-norm ratio >= 1 on either of the last two ratios (NEW-7); or a pass-row gap / row-ID defect exists (B4, S9). E_i(pair) = E_i(a) + E_i(b). The geometric bound assumes the observed ratio is the map's contraction factor: DECLARED, checked against each run's own increments.

decidable_iff.text: E_i(pair) + E^A_i(pair) <= tau_i/8 on every row

decidability_scope.text: Decidability applies to T1_H, T2 and T3 (pass texts say "decidable"); not to T1, T2c, T1_S or RB_FP.

if_not_decidable_R_PAIR.text: R-PAIR once, branch chosen on the worst undecidable row (largest (E + E^A)/tau): if E is unavailable, branch PICARD; else if E^A_i(pair) > E_i(pair) on that row, branch ROUTE_A, otherwise PICARD. ROUTE_A members recompute route A with route_a.seed_source_rtol_factor 0.1 (absent = 1.0, byte-identical; B0 covers absence); their route-A identity must differ from the base's (NEW-16); the C5H ROUTE_A member carries ro1_workers true. PICARD members admit their base run's route A (route_a.column_workers = 1 is a registered PICARD leaf, byte-equal between members), with picard.passes 12 and speed_change_bound_km_s 0.0025 (byte-equal between members); V6 requires route_a_outcome.result_sha256 equal to the base's; a T-case PICARD member's RO1 record equals its base's canonically and its worker-kind check uses the admitted attempt's worker (R3-4); the C5H PICARD member carries no ro1_workers and reads ro1 armed false, fired false. Each member is validated against its partner and against its base, with only the registered R-PAIR leaves allowed to differ; a member's V2 uses its registered speed bound. C5H members run under v010 tail OFF with the RO1 workers where their branch computes route A, admitted through B0 identity, with worker/binding pins on the declared custody list. A manifest naming R-PAIR members for a test whose R-PAIR was not triggered is refused at load, before any test is read (NEW-17). PICARD members inherit their base run's flag and a cleared base clears them; ROUTE_A members carry their own flags. Still not decidable -> UNDECIDABLE_AT_ITERATION_FLOOR (reported; the test neither passes nor fails).

RB_FP.text: RB-FP_i = 2 * eps_max * |dv_i/dlambda| * kappa_i <= tau_i/10; dv_i/dlambda := (|v_i(C4T-A) - v_i(C4T)| + E_i(C4T-A, C4T))/0.05 (conservative); the noise contribution 2 kappa_i eps E_i/0.05 is recorded; kappa_i = sum_s|dV_static_is| / |sum_s dV_static_is| (shell split, saved C4T); first-order response DECLARED, UNTESTED. E is the Picard allowance only. RB_FP with undefined kappa reads INCOMPLETE. Shell labels are read by index and never emitted verbatim in blinded modes (S6).

T1.text: Pass iff cases C2T, C3T, C4T are valid AND V005 criterion.shape_pass literally (Dhat_T(3,4) <= 1 AND Dhat_T(3,4) <= 0.5 * Dhat_T(2,3)) AND RA6: for every row i, d23_i * d34_i >= 0 and |d34_i| <= 1/2 |d23_i|, where d23_i = v_i(C3T) - v_i(C2T), d34_i = v_i(C4T) - v_i(C3T); if d23_i = 0 the row passes only if d34_i = 0. TINY (DECLARED; applies to the RA6 clause only): a row is TINY iff |d23_i| <= tau_i/8 and |d34_i| <= tau_i/8; TINY rows are exempt from the per-row clause and stay in Dhat. No floor clause; FLOOR_LIKE pre-named (D14). Known blind spot (G5): a growing row whose increments both stay <= tau/8 is exempt; the backstop is T1_H.

Placed directly after NO_RUN. Any registered V007 case (T-runs, C5H, identity-gate runs) invalid or missing, including BRACKET_HULL_MISS, a missing receipt, a pass-row gap or row-ID defect, RB_FP with undefined kappa -> name each case and gate with its next step; no T-test is read. Subtypes: CASES_OR_RECORDS (tests unread) and UNRESOLVED (tests read: ADOPT_TAIL or FLAG_PENDING_RULING with a pending step; a NOT_UV/SRKD split that turns on a flag).

Same position. NUMERICS_UNCERTIFIED: EPS uncertified, DOUBLING fails, GQ fails or a GQ/EPS coverage shortfall. NON_LAPSE_TAIL_MATERIAL: LO fails (LO_NGC for NGC readings). Next: named successor. No T-test is read.

outcomes_first_applicable.outcome: decided failure outcomes, in R1 order
outcomes_first_applicable.text: Read in this order: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT: T2 decidable and fails; stop, T1/T3 not read as physics (also a T2I failure: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT (T2I), A48 AMB-10) | SOURCE_RULE_MATERIAL: T2c fails; root ruling on the gas rule before adoption | KBIG_NOT_CONVERGED: T3 fails; next step: RI-07 (R1's "production K_big 64 under T3prime (32/64/128), EPS and LO to 128" is superseded by P = 128) | BOUND_INSUFFICIENT: RB_FP or SRB_ROT fails; next: q-corrected shell (second asymptotic order), design successor | FLOOR_LIKE (D14): T1 fails only by a contraction clause (max-based or per-row, RA6) with Dhat_T(2,3) <= 1 and Dhat_T(3,4) <= 1; takes precedence over the two T1-fail readings below; a floor clause needs a new prereg version before any further case | NOT_UV_RESIDUAL: T1 fails AND T2c <= tau_i/4 every row AND SR-K pairwise K-dependence (2,3),(3,4) <= tau_i/4 AND no TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED flag; next: column/Picard map, own prereg | SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_K_DEPENDENT: T1 fails otherwise; next: fixed-point SR runs C2T-SR/C3T-SR/C4T-SR (packets over the smooth source), own design and prereg | HIGHER_K_DISAGREEMENT: T1 passes and T1_H fails; adopt nothing; C6T candidate under a V007 amendment sealed before further results | SHAPE_DISAGREEMENT: T1_S fails; review per-stage C wiring. A decided failure is read when its own condition is fully decided even if another step is unresolved; the pending steps are listed.

Only if no decided failure outcome applies and some test with a TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED run failed (flags are evaluated per test: a flagged test that passes, passes with the flag carried; one that fails is undecidable and cannot trigger IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT, NOT_UV_RESIDUAL, SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_K_DEPENDENT or FLOOR_LIKE). Next: rerun that case with seed source_rtol/10.
A paired test still undecidable after R-PAIR: neither pass nor fail; no adoption. Both undecidable readings are listed when both apply.

Every gate and test passes but a flag stays unruled (SOURCE_QUADRATURE_MATERIAL, or TAIL_SOURCE_UNDERCONVERGED on an adoption run); no adoption; needs every step resolved; root rules on the flag (a flag ruling is a root addendum entry naming the flag, run and evidence, registered before any adoption reads the flagged test).
The decision rule holds and every step is resolved.

outcome_reading_rules.text: Any reading made while a step at an earlier position is pending is marked PROVISIONAL, with the pending steps listed. A decided T3, T1-split or SHAPE reading stands while T2/T2I is pending, marked PROVISIONAL.
"No T-test is read" applies to NO_RUN, INCOMPLETE and NUMERICS_UNCERTIFIED/NON_LAPSE_TAIL_MATERIAL; T values may be reported descriptively, labelled "not read".
Governing principle: no ruling may make adoption easier than the text; where the text is silent the stricter-on-adoption reading is chosen.
A V1-V6 failure other than BRACKET_HULL_MISS -> named defect, fix and rerun that case under V007 with thresholds unchanged.
